topics.title: Her stall
topics.summary: What sells, what doesn't, and why.
topics.answer: Pills sell. Hope sells better. I sell pills.

topics.title: Prices & caravans
topics.summary: Why goods from Blazing Mountain cost more.
topics.answer: Every caravan that crosses the Blazing Mountain loses a cart. You pay for the cart.

topics.title: Haggling tips
topics.summary: How to get a better price out of her.
topics.answer: Raise your Sect Fame. I give discounts to people who can protect my caravans.

topics.title: Sect rumours
topics.summary: Harmless gossip about everyone in the sect.
topics.answer: Senior Sister Bai polishes her sword at midnight. Every midnight. Make of that what you will.

topics.title: Life on the Mortal Plains
topics.answer: Three sisters, one goat, no money. The goat was the smart one.

topics.title: Why she needs so much money
topics.summary: The question she always laughs off.
topics.answer: …My sisters are still on the plains. Foundation Pills are expensive. Don't tell anyone.

topics.title: Her lucky coin
topics.summary: The first coin she ever stole—earned.
topics.answer: I earned it. Mostly. Here—hold it. No, you can keep it.
